caption: The drawing features a bust of a woman with a pale complexion, black hair styled in tight curls framing her face, and red lips. She is clothed in a brown garment with a knotted detail at the chest and draped with a red sash that wraps across her shoulders and chest. The red sash appears gathered and has folds, adding a sense of texture. There is a circular decorative medallion on her upper arm, yellow in color. Below the red sash, part of the lower bust is visible in a dark blue or gray shade. The background is plain, off-white or beige, with no additional objects. In the lower right corner, there is a small, lightly sketched version of the same bust in pencil, showing an outline with minimal detail.
title: Small Figurehead
